text: The evidence shows significant forest loss in the surrounding region. The data indicates that there was tree cover in the year 2000, but by 2020, there was no forest cover observed. Additionally, there were several tree-cover loss events recorded before the 2020 baseline, with the most substantial loss occurring in 2020, amounting to 67.7 hectares. These observations are corroborated by data from the University of Maryland (Hansen/UMD) and the European Commission Joint Research Centre. Therefore, it is clear that forest loss has occurred across the surrounding region.
